provenance.asset_description: Pathfinder Society Second Editon The Year of Battle's Spark: Battle of the Thorns. The background art is of  Zarta Dralneen as she moved pieces around a battle map as her wayfinder illuminates the scene. Pathfinders and Andoren soldiers moving in the background of a busy war camp. The overlayed image is of a pale skinned woman with round markings on her face outlining her eyes, cheeks, and jaw. She's dressed in dark clothes, with a chain wrapped around her waist, standing with her hands on her hips.
